notes: Machine-readable mirror of the Agent-reachable action registry. Kept in sync by app/src/test/java/com/leslie/teachtrack/copilot/CapabilitiesJsonSyncTest.kt. All actions are reachable via `teachtrack rpc --json '{"action":"...","params":{...}}'` and go through CopilotService -> LocalCopilotActionRegistry -> TeachTrackRepository -> Room, the same path the UI uses. `destructive: true` marks actions that remove or overwrite data; all of them are soft operations (archive/soft-delete/ID-merge) per the project's archive-before-delete principle. Read-only actions (no confirmationRequired) are exactly those with `readOnly: true`.

actions.name: student.create
actions.description: Create a student profile; refuses exact duplicate names.

actions.name: student.update
actions.description: Update a student profile (blank fields keep old values). ARCHIVED is excluded; use student.archive.

actions.name: student.search
actions.description: Search students by name or displayName; returns count + studentIds.

actions.name: student.archive
actions.description: Soft-archive a student; all history is retained (archive-before-delete principle).

actions.name: student.overview.query
actions.description: One-student summary: profile, latest course, recent scores, pending homework, open problems, weak knowledge.

actions.name: student.data.organize.preview
actions.description: Cross-module data-organization report over ACTIVE students; makes no writes.

actions.name: student.followup.tasks.create
actions.description: Create follow-up tasks from the organize report findings (dedupes existing).

actions.name: course.create
actions.description: Record a course session (auto-creates lesson plan / problem record side rows, same as UI).

actions.name: course.resume
actions.description: Return the previous lesson's nextLessonPlan and open the new-course dialog.

actions.name: course.timeline
actions.description: Open the student timeline; reports the course-record count.

actions.name: course.query

params.studentId/studentName: optional; omit for global recent courses

actions.description: List recent course sessions (per student, or latest 10 across all students).

actions.name: exam.create
actions.description: Create an exam record.

actions.name: exam.query
actions.description: List the 15 most recent exams with ids.

actions.name: score.create
actions.description: Record a score (creates the exam by name if missing; optional lost-score item).

actions.name: score.query
actions.description: List a student's recent scores.

actions.name: score.trend
actions.description: Score-rate trend line for a student (last 10, chronological) plus direction (上升/下降/平稳).

actions.name: knowledge.create
actions.description: Create a knowledge point; refuses duplicate names.

actions.name: knowledge.update
actions.description: Record a student's mastery level for a knowledge point (writes progress + event).

actions.name: knowledge.query

params.studentId/studentName: optional; omit for global knowledge-point count

actions.description: List a student's knowledge-progress rows with levels and notes.

actions.name: knowledge.weakness.query
actions.description: Find ACTIVE students weak in a named knowledge point.

actions.name: homework.create
actions.description: Assign homework to a student.

actions.name: homework.query
actions.description: List homework (pending by default; per student or global).

actions.name: problem.create
actions.description: Record a problem/mistake entry; returns problemId.

actions.name: problem.status.update
actions.description: Update a problem record's status (待复习/复习中/已改善/已解决).

actions.name: problem.query
actions.description: List problem records with ids (open by default).

actions.name: lesson_plan.create
actions.description: Set the next-lesson plan for a student.

actions.name: lesson_plan.query
actions.description: List upcoming lesson plans (per student or global).

actions.name: communication.create
actions.description: Record a parent-communication entry (also saves a primary contact when contact given, same as UI).

actions.name: communication.query
actions.description: List a student's recent communication records.

actions.name: parent_contact.create
actions.description: Add a parent contact for a student.

actions.name: parent_contact.query
actions.description: List a student's parent contacts.

actions.name: task.create
actions.description: Create a todo; returns taskId.

actions.name: task.status.update

params.title: fallback: unique substring match among open tasks
params.status: 已完成/待处理 (default 已完成)

actions.description: Mark a todo done/pending with the exact UI status vocabulary.

actions.name: task.query
actions.description: List todos with ids (pending by default).

actions.name: timeline.query
actions.description: Merged recent events (courses/scores/homework/communications/problems), mirroring the StudentTimeline UI.

actions.name: analytics.query
actions.description: Global counts: courses, exams, scores; opens the analytics tab.

actions.name: dashboard.query
actions.description: Dashboard headline: active students + pending tasks; opens the home tab.

actions.name: search.global
actions.description: One query across students, knowledge points, templates and tags.

actions.name: template.create
actions.description: Save a feedback template.

actions.name: template.list
actions.description: List feedback templates.

actions.name: template.update
actions.description: Update a template's content by name.

actions.name: template.delete
actions.description: Hard-delete a template by name (the only hard delete in the registry; templates carry no student history).

actions.name: template.render
actions.description: Render a template with variables, reusing TemplateRenderer.

actions.name: tag.create
actions.description: Create a tag.

actions.name: tag.assign
actions.description: Assign a tag to a student (creates the tag if missing).

actions.name: tag.query
actions.description: List all tags.

actions.name: tag.student.query
actions.description: List the tags assigned to one student.

actions.name: attachment.list
actions.description: Count all local attachment records.

actions.name: attachment.query
actions.description: List a student's attachments.

actions.name: attachment.delete
actions.description: Soft-delete an attachment record (deletedAt marker; file on disk untouched).

actions.name: backup.export
actions.description: Write a full JSON backup into the app's own ai-backups/ directory.

actions.name: backup.list
actions.description: List AI-created local backups.

actions.name: backup.restore
actions.description: Restore a backup by ID-merge (never deletes existing data).

actions.name: csv.export.scores
actions.description: Export the scores CSV into ai-backups/ (same export the Settings screen produces).

actions.name: workspace.status.query
actions.description: Report the connected workspace manifest (name/id/schema).

actions.name: workspace.export
actions.description: Export Room data into the connected workspace.

actions.name: workspace.check
actions.description: Run the workspace integrity check.

actions.name: workspace.sync.scan
actions.description: Scan workspace sync events and conflicts.

actions.name: workspace.conflict.list
actions.description: List unresolved sync conflicts.

actions.name: workspace.conflict.resolve
actions.description: Record a conflict-resolution decision (records the choice only; never overwrites either version).

actions.name: navigation.open

params.destination: optional: 首页/学生/计划/统计/设置/agent

actions.description: Switch TeachTrack's bottom-nav tab (CopilotEffect.OpenTab).

actions.name: ui.open.tab

params.destination: optional: 首页/学生/计划/统计/设置/agent

actions.description: Alias of navigation.open (ui.open.* namespace form).

actions.name: ui.open.student
actions.description: Open a student's workspace screen (CopilotEffect.OpenStudent); resolves names like any other action.

actions.name: batch.tasks.create

params.items: required: JSON array, max 50, of {title, studentName?, dueDate?, priority?, notes?}

actions.description: Create many todos in one call; per-item failure isolation; returns taskIds.

actions.name: batch.scores.create

params.items: required: JSON array, max 50, of {studentId|studentName, score, fullScore?, examName?, date?, subject?, classRank?, gradeRank?, category?, lostScore?}

actions.description: Record many scores in one call; identical validation to score.create (shared createScoreRecord); strict per-item ok/error in data.items.

actions.name: batch.courses.create

params.items: required: JSON array, max 50, of {studentId|studentName, content, date?, subject?, title?, problems?, nextLessonPlan?, teacherNotes?}

actions.description: Record many course sessions in one call; identical validation to course.create (shared createCourseRecord); strict per-item ok/error in data.items.

actions.name: batch.tags.assign

params.items: required: JSON array, max 50, of {studentId|studentName, tagName}

actions.description: Assign a tag to many students in one call (e.g. 标记重点关注); identical behavior to tag.assign (creates missing tags); strict per-item ok/error in data.items.

actions.name: batch.tasks.complete

params.items: required: JSON array, max 50, of {taskId} or {title}

actions.description: Mark many todos done in one call; same taskId-wins / unique-title-match resolution as task.status.update; strict per-item ok/error in data.items.
